records.value: Sole proprietors and partners: business profit is added to the individual's other income and taxed at resident progressive rates (0% on the first S$20,000 of chargeable income, top rate 24% from YA 2024); there is no separate business tax and no turnover-based exemption. Private limited companies: flat 17% on chargeable income. Qualifying new companies get the start-up tax exemption for their first 3 Years of Assessment (75% of the first S$100,000 and 50% of the next S$100,000 of normal chargeable income exempt); other companies get the partial tax exemption (75% of the first S$10,000 and 50% of the next S$190,000). YA 2026: CIT Rebate of 50% of tax payable, capped at S$40,000 (less a S$2,000 cash grant where applicable).
